summary: REQ-6 appears implemented: TanStack Router now registers public and admin routes under the /echofields base path, including /echofields/$clueId and /echofields/admin, with a redirect from / to /echofields. No old top-level clue routes are registered in the provided diff summary.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduced a new (empty) Motoko backend actor file.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest only asked for frontend routing changes (REQ-6) and did not request adding or altering backend logic/files.

hallucinated_features.description: Added an Internet Identity authentication hook/provider and actor-creation hook plumbing.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-6 requires admin routes remain reachable and still require Internet Identity authentication for admin actions, but it did not request implementing the full auth hook/provider infrastructure as part of this change.

hallucinated_features.description: Implemented mock clue data and CRUD-like operations via React Query hooks.
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-6 is about URL path structure (/echofields/...) and route registration; it does not request building or mocking the clue data layer.

hallucinated_features.description: Added new UI pages/components (Home, CluePage, AdminPage, Header, Footer) and styling/theme setup (Tailwind CSS config and global CSS, ThemeProvider).
hallucinated_features.reason: REQ-6 focuses on updating routing paths to include 'echofields'; these additional UI/UX features are not explicitly requested in the BuildRequest.
